name: io.github.normahubcc/mcp-server-normahub
description: NormaHub MCP server: chat, image, video and audio models with a live model catalog.

environmentVariables.name: NORMAHUB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from https://normahub.cc/dashboard. Required for chat, image, video and audio tools.

environmentVariables.name: NORMAHUB_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model used by normahub_prompt_model when the caller omits one.

environmentVariables.name: NORMAHUB_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the live catalog and use the bundled snapshot.
